result.summary: Several layout and content clipping issues are visible: restaurant names and category chips are cut off, a promo badge shows a nonsensical '-100%' label, and horizontal carousels lack clear overflow affordances.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you row, and the third card is partially off-screen without a clear way to see the full name.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card titles wrap to two lines or scale/truncate with ellipsis consistently, and give horizontal lists enough padding and a peek of the next card so names remain readable.

issues.description: The pizza card shows a green badge reading '-100%', which looks like a broken or incorrect discount label rather than a meaningful offer (e.g. 100% off or free item).
issues.suggestion: Correct the badge copy to a valid promotion (e.g. '-50%' or '100% off') or hide the badge when the value is invalid.

issues.description: Category filter chips (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) overflow horizontally and the last chip is clipped at the right edge with no clear scroll indicator.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scroll with padding and a subtle fade or partial next-chip peek so users know more categories exist.

issues.description: Delivery time pills on the Fastest near you cards sit over the images with heavy white fills that can clash with varied food photography and reduce visual polish.
issues.suggestion: Use a semi-transparent or frosted pill style and consistent positioning so overlays remain legible without dominating the image.

issues.description: Bottom navigation labels and icons rely mainly on color for the selected Home state; Search/Orders/Profile are low-contrast gray and may be harder to distinguish for some users.
issues.suggestion: Increase contrast for unselected tab labels and ensure selected state is not conveyed by color alone (e.g. weight or icon fill).
